meta.name: doc-coauthoring
meta.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按结构化流程协作撰写文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要与他人协作撰写结构化的文档或提案
copy.tagline_en: Collaborate on structured documentation with a guided workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to co-author structured documents or proposals with others

howto.what: Claude 会引导你分三步完成文档共创：先收集背景信息，再逐节构思和修改，最后用另一个 Claude 测试文档是否清晰易懂。
howto.when: 当你提到写文档、提案、技术规格或类似任务时，Claude 会主动提供这个结构化流程。

say.text: 帮我写一份技术方案文档，用共创流程。
say.note: Claude 会启动三阶段流程，先问你背景信息。

say.text: 我们一起来起草一份决策文档。
say.note: Claude 会引导你逐步构建文档内容。

say.text: 写完后帮我测试一下文档是否清晰。
say.note: Claude 会进入读者测试阶段，用另一个实例检查。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through a three-stage co-authoring workflow: gather context, refine each section through brainstorming and editing, then test the document with a fresh Claude instance to catch blind spots.
howto.when_en: When you mention writing docs, proposals, technical specs, or similar tasks, Claude offers this structured workflow.

say_en.text: Help me write a technical spec using the co-authoring workflow.
say_en.note: Claude starts the three-stage process by asking for background.

say_en.text: Let's draft a decision document together.
say_en.note: Claude guides you through building the document step by step.

say_en.text: After writing, test the document for clarity.
say_en.note: Claude enters reader testing stage with a fresh instance.
